title: Find Consecutive Integers from a Data Stream
summary: Design a stream checker: consec(num) appends num and returns true only when the most recent k integers are all equal to value; it returns false while fewer than k integers have arrived.
officialConstraints: 1 <= value, num <= 10^9; 1 <= k <= 10^5; at most 10^5 calls to consec (from the recovered statement).
